text: You've got five agents running. Which one needs you right now?
With queue flow, you don't have to check. Attn lines up the agents waiting for you, oldest first.
Press Command J, and you're with the one that has waited longest.
Answer it, settle it with Command Shift E, and Attn brings you the next.
When nobody is waiting, you land on Home. All settled. The rest are busy working, so you can forget about them.
The moment one finishes or gets stuck, Attn brings you to it.
Stop checking on your agents. Let them come to you.
